set.body:
Outcome: lodge the owner-authorized four-workstream reality-check follow-through in Mote under reality-check-20261015, with scoped children, real dependency edges and falsifiable acceptance criteria.

Owner instruction, 15 October 2026: proceed with the four reality-check recommendations; grakern must remain pinned to GitHub for now. This task records the plan; implementing and qualifying its runtime/research children is separate work.

Scope: current pointers in docs/refactor/PLAN.md and docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md; existing delivery/release/Native/research Mote records and narrow new children. Preserve historical bodies and evidence. The immediate distribution route is an immutable GitHub source build plus offline CLI; unresolved Maven dependencies remain deferred publication, not a passing public-resolution result. Research does not block software qualification.

Acceptance: every workstream has a named issue, inputs, output, falsifier, dependency and stop condition; new issues are deduplicated; Mote graph has no introduced cycles or research-to-release blockers; exact-SHA independent review and git diff --check pass; tracker changes and plan pointers are committed. No runtime gate is required for this docs/tracker-only slice (T2).

Next action: reserve the two index files, create the bounded plan children, annotate superseded priorities, review and commit the plan. Leave the delivery/release parents open.
set.title: [reality-check] Record the four-workstream execution plan
